name: Cinnamon Rolls
desc: Soft yeasted rolls with brown sugar-cinnamon filling and cream cheese frosting

ingredients.raw: Dough: water, butter, vanilla pudding, milk, egg, sugar, salt, bread flour, yeast
Filling: butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, pecans
Frosting: cream cheese, butter, powdered sugar, vanilla, milk

steps: Combine dough in bread machine on Dough cycle.
Roll, spread butter, sprinkle filling. Roll up, slice into 16. Place in buttered pan.
Mix frosting. Spread over warm rolls.
